concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-account-updater-node]] - feature-restricted Account Updater daily-report webhook, including its 24-hour updated-method scope, no-updates suppression, payload-category route, and one-week report-link expiry
warnings: Keep availability limited to merchants using Braintree's Account Updater feature; do not infer universal merchant access or undocumented enablement terms.

Preserve the report-level trigger: the daily report covers vaulted payment methods updated in the last 24 hours, and no updates means no webhook; do not recast it as one webhook per payment-method update.
The Attributes section provides concatenated categories without visible field names; do not invent identifiers or a complete report schema.
Do not infer report format, download authentication, delivery timing, retry, ordering, duplicate-handling, or individual update success from the webhook description.
